preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The value of k is between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' if len(S) < k else True
postconditions.description: If the length of S is less than k, return '-1'.
The length of the returned string is the length of S minus k.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] <= return_value[i+1] for i in range(len(return_value)-1))
postconditions.description: The returned string is lexicographically smallest.
